comment: The Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak trash (BNpcBase 1360): 1340 HP, level 24; auto-attack 872 every 3.0 s, 344 every 4.4 s, 345 (a 2.2 s cast: status 18, a poison, for 15 s) every 20.8 s. For 364, 345 and 1014, which only poison, the recorded amount is the poison's tick (retail's ActionEffect gives it with the status). From Bob's Chronofoil captures of the Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak (2026-10-30): one run with Duty Support (caa5e908, visit 0.15) and one Duty Finder run (1fac2416, visit 0.15), `questkit chronofoil --battle`. `players` is the median damage to players over the two runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
